nodes.title: Cyberlearn Architecture
nodes.content:
# Cyberlearn - Complete Architecture Overview

A comprehensive cybersecurity learning platform built with **Django backend** and **React frontend**.

**Key Components:**
- Backend: Django REST Framework + PostgreSQL/SQLite
- Frontend: React with modern UI
- Authentication: JWT with Cookie-based storage
- Learning Content: Lessons, Tasks, Progress Tracking

nodes.title: Backend System
nodes.content:
## Django Backend

**Location:** `cyberlearn/` + `learning/`

**Core Technologies:**
- Django 4.x
- Django REST Framework
- PostgreSQL/SQLite
- JWT Authentication
- CORS Support

*See: Backend Architecture Map for details*

nodes.title: Frontend System
nodes.content:
## React Frontend

**Location:** `Front-End/client/`

**Core Technologies:**
- React 18+
- React Router
- Axios for API calls
- Modern CSS/Styling

*See: Frontend Architecture Map for details*

nodes.title: Database Models
nodes.content:
## Data Layer

**Location:** `learning/models.py`

**Core Models:**
- User (Django Auth)
- Lesson
- ContentBlocks
- TaskBlocks
- UserProgress
- UserProfile
- Note

*See: Database Models Map for details*

nodes.title: Authentication
nodes.content:
## Auth Flow

**Location:** `learning/authentication.py` + `views.py`

**Features:**
- Email-based login
- JWT tokens with refresh
- HttpOnly cookies
- CSRF protection

*See: Authentication Flow Map for details*

nodes.title: API Endpoints
nodes.content:
## REST API

**Location:** `learning/urls.py` + `views.py`

**Main Routes:**
- `/api/lessons/`
- `/api/progress/`
- `/api/token/` (Auth)
- `/api/notes/`
- `/api/tasks/<id>/submit/`

*See: API Endpoints Map for details*
